newsitem.title: SPAIN: Belarus tourists stranded in Spain after drug bust.
newsitem.headline: Belarus tourists stranded in Spain after drug bust.

text.p: A group of Belarus tourists were left stranded in Barcelona after police found 80 kilos of heroine stashed in their tour bus, police said on Tuesday.

Spanish police said they had arrested the two Belarus drivers and one Turkish companion suspected of hiding the drugs in the bus which travelled from central Europe to Spain undetected with 30 unwitting Belarus tourists on board.
Sniffer dogs discovered the heroine with a street value of around 1.5 billion pesetas ($11.5 million) hidden on the coach when it arrived in Barcelona on Monday.
Police said the tourists were awaiting help from their embassy in Paris after police confiscated their coach.
